goal: Publish a stable VII release that fixes all verified release-596 public defects and preserves the complete existing product.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix everything found, include anything not yet published, test the whole site except accessibility and typography, and release a stable version.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The public platform must stop losing tabs, stalling results and loading states, breaking media or diverging across worlds after updates.
likely_rejections: Only the latest slider symptom is fixed
One tab or world is still missing
Local tests pass but production remains broken
The repair removes a previously working capability

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Every verified audit finding is either fixed and passed or retained as an explicit release blocker
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A numbered finding-to-fix ledger and no unresolved critical or high issue

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: All distinct public route and component families, not every duplicated sitemap URL
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A complete family inventory and representative data variants on desktop and mobile

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Visitors see complete choices and stable results without understanding supplier or cache failures.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Select world, dates, location or a clearly labeled period or holiday.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open a verified result or recover from an explicit empty or error state.
preserved_depth: map gallery rooms reviews phone WhatsApp and booking modes

facts.claim: The nearby homepage API can return only one display period because it filters configured periods to available cache snapshots.
The holiday API intentionally slices the result using a default limit of six.

assumptions.claim: The intermittent blank document is downstream of uncontained async request or RSC failure rather than deterministic route markup.
assumptions.validation: Worker logs, controlled failures and post-fix repeated navigation

in_scope: all homepage and regional slider tabs
media data map and public copy fixes
build deploy rollback and live family QA
out_of_scope: real booking payment lead review or message submission
invariants: phone and WhatsApp remain visible where verified
vacation room and sleeping-detail cards remain
all active languages and canonical URLs remain

requirements.statement: All five configured nearby tabs remain visible and independently truthful.
All eligible future holidays appear without a six-item public cap.
requirements.source: User request and prior accepted feedback

requirements.statement: Search continuation reaches at least 18 results by nearest expansion when sufficient public records exist.
Every async search or slider request terminates in results, honest empty or actionable error without blanking the page.
Every verified media, data, map and price-format defect from release 596 is repaired across its shared family.
The exact tested commit is deployed with rollback and passes full public family QA on desktop and mobile.

acceptance_checks.setup: Fresh homepage with one or more unavailable cache periods
acceptance_checks.action: Load and select every nearby period
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Five tabs stay visible and each reports only its own results, empty or error state

acceptance_checks.setup: Supplier returns more than six eligible future holidays
acceptance_checks.action: Load endpoint and homepage, then reload
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every eligible non-hidden holiday is returned and remains selectable

acceptance_checks.setup: Search for a location with fewer than 18 exact local matches
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The list fills to at least 18 using nearest public matches or ends with an honest total when the entire corpus is smaller

acceptance_checks.action: Observe automatic recovery and manual retry
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The existing document remains visible and the component ends in results, empty or an actionable error within a bounded time

acceptance_checks.action: Observe the affected component and use its retry control
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The page remains intact, a localized actionable error replaces the loader, and retry starts one new bounded request cycle

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative affected pages in all worlds
acceptance_checks.action: Load media, maps, capacity and price content
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No broken provider image, zero capacity claim, legacy shekel text or cross-world map divergence remains

acceptance_checks.action: Save and deploy exact pushed commit
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Production reports the candidate release, full family QA passes and release 596 remains a verified rollback

acceptance_checks.setup: Fresh production navigation across changed families
acceptance_checks.action: Reload, back, retry and mobile-to-desktop transition
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No blank body, stale overlay, stuck loader or lost state appears

authorization_boundary: Implementation, testing, commit, push and public Sites deployment are authorized. External commercial submissions remain prohibited.
